notes.title: Steel Rain Update 1.7.1 has been released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10710920/7e137bc89bf1e920aeb5815ea517584831d4f9cb.jpg[/img]

[h1]New features[/h1]

- New resolution support up to 4k [i](full list below)[/i]
- Display resolution detection and recommendation
- Resolution reset switch and confirm countdown added
- Safemode startup parameter added to reset resolution settings
- Mouselock / Autofire auto adjust if contradictory


[h1]Improvements[/h1]

- Increased laser movement and enemy collision detection speed
- Wing and Drone gun muzzle redesign
- Bullet and Missile movement speeds adjustments
- Background moving speed and screen ratio adjustemnts
- Power Up messages redesign and new relative positioning
- Damage numbers redesign for better readability
- Optimized resolution scaling and layer positioning
- Increased menu stats calc speed
- Improved overall game performance
- Overload and Armor penetration collision effects reduced
- Improved Wing Weapon detail anim  and resolution scaling
- Enemy income warning only on the left side of the screen
- Optimized video options and slide bars
- Editor resolution scaling and options positioning improved
- Editor minimap navigation improved and scaling adjusted


[h1]Balancing[/h1]

- Different enemies hp re-balance and new placements
- Improved timing and positioning for rear attack enemies


[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]

- Menu and Button stats flickering fix
- Stage restart enemy positioning fix
- Bonus Stage Red Mine resolution scaling fix
- Relative UI distance on low resolutions fix
- Laser resolution height scaling fix
- Angle corrections for different bullet types


[h1]Supported resolutions[/h1]

3840 x 2400 *New
3840 x 2160 *New
2560 x 1600 *New
2560 x 1440 *New
2048 x 1280 *New
2048 x 1152 *New
1920 x 1400 *New
1920 x 1200 *New
1920 x 1080
1680 x 1050
1600 x 900
1440 x 900
1366 x 768 *New
1360 x 768
1280 x 1024
1280 x 960
1280 x 800
1280 x 768
1280 x 720


[h1]Note[/h1]

Resolutions above 1920x1080 can be partially scaled and also have heavy impact on performance. A resolution change requires a confirmation or it will be set back to the initial resolution after 10 seconds. If you have selected an invalid resolution, you can wait 10 seconds for it's reset or start the game with the "-safemode" parameter, that will reset the resolution, effects and details to minimum. After changing the settings in the safemode, a restart is required to enter normal mode. 

[i]We hope you enjoy, feedback is very welcome!	[/i]

notes.title: Steel Rain Update 1.5.0 has been released

Dear players, Steel Rain Update 1.5.0 is now available and adds many new features, optimizations and fixes. Next to the improved and redesigned campaign mode, there are 2 new game modes, Arcade and Survival. Arcade mode allows you to play Steel Rain with a simplified alternative Upgrade system, auto refilling Quickbar and unlocked Skills. In Survival mode you have no quick bar items, no way to save your game and no hp refill. Fight as far as possible and compete with other players. All new game modes come with separate leaderboards, unique space missions and more new features.
